title: Is autism curable with occupational therapy?
metaTitle: Effect of Occupational Therapy on Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how occupational therapy can effectively manage the symptoms of autism and improve the quality of life for children. Learn how therapies enhance social interactions, motor skills, and daily living.
html: While autism is not “curable”, occupational therapy can significantly help with managing the symptoms and improving quality of life for children with autism. Therapies help in building up their social interactions, motor skills, and daily living skills.
